thread:
maria: Ok team — kicking off a short sync to build a 'tradeoff workbench' for the upcoming PRD. Focus: kernel selection + KV cache policy + launch gates. We need crisp acceptance criteria and a prioritized matrix of customer asks. :eyes:

aj: +1. Can we slot this into sprint planning tomorrow? Need input from SRE on canary windows.

neil: I can do perf runs for the candidate kernels. Quick Q: do we include quantized variants in the same rollout or treat as fallback only?

tim: Treat quantized as fallback initially. We should avoid mixing in first canary to reduce variables. `fallback_model=v1-quant`.

infra-bot: perf-run results cross-posted: <https://ci.redwood/perf/2189> (P50/P95 matrix attached)

sara: From PM/customer side: two enterprise customers asked for deterministic latency under 100ms P95 for short chats. They are ok with small quality delta if we document it.

maria: Noted. Let's record acceptance candidates. Proposal:
``` 
Acceptance candidates:
- SLO-A: P50 <= 50ms @ 32 tokens
- SLO-B: P95 <= 120ms @ 32 tokens for hosted tier
- Degradation path: automatic fallback to quant variant within 40-60ms if kernel-caused latency spike
- Functional: pass eval set (A/B) with <=1.5% quality regression
Canary plan:
- 5% traffic, 24h, rollback if >2 regression alerts or 3x error rate
``` 
Is that too strict?

neil: P95 120ms is optimistic depending on model size. For 13B on A100s that's plausible, for 70B not. Need per-model buckets in PRD.

aj: Agreed. Let's make buckets: Small(<=7B), Medium(8-35B), Large(>35B). Each gets tailored kernel + quant planning.

maria: Good. I'll draft a matrix in the PRD. Columns: model_bucket, kernel_candidate, expected_p50/p95, kv_policy (prefetch/evict), fallback_timeout, canary_percent. Anyone want to own kernel eval matrix?

neil: I'll own kernel eval. Plan: run 3 kernels x 3 seq-lens x 2000 samples. ETA 48h.

tim: SRE input on KV: recommend `prefetch=true` for small/medium, `aggressive-evict` for large to avoid memory pressure. We'll test eviction thresholds.

sara: Customer asks: per-route pinning and an SLA for fallback behavior. Make sure product owners sign off on fallback SLA wording.

maria: Action items:
- neil: run kernel eval (48h)
- tim: define KV eviction thresholds + test plan
- sara: capture customer SLA language
- aj: add sprint slot + link PRD draft
I'll create the PRD draft here: <https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/tradeoff-workbench-2189> and ping when ready. :thumbsup:

oliver: Quick note — include a "blacklist" for kernel variants that regress hallucination rates in evals. We had one before.

maria: Good catch. Add eval checks for semantic safety and hallucination regression.

infra-bot: ticket created: INF-2189 "tradeoff workbench PRD + kernel/kv launch criteria" assigned to maria. Link: <https://tracker.redwood/INF-2189>

aj: Thanks. I'll block 30m tomorrow to align SRE and product.

maria: Perfect. We'll reconvene after neil's runs. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it in this thread. Thanks all. :rocket:
